title: WordFinder: A Browser-Based KWIC Concordancer for Corpus Analysis
description: WordFinder is a browser-based Shiny application that produces Key-Word-in-Context (KWIC) concordances for uploaded plain-text files. Users can search for single words or multi-word patterns, sort concordance lines by left or right context, and export the resulting concordance table as CSV or Excel. Search is regex-aware and supports case-insensitive matching. WordFinder is designed for teaching and research in corpus linguistics, sociolinguistics, and the digital humanities, and requires no local installation of R.
